signals.text: 1 new PM role posted this week

roles.title: Staff Product Manager, In Store Offerings

bullets: Shift restaurant software from outputs to outcomes. Build experiences that synthesize what matters, explain why it matters, recommend the next best action, and make it easy to act.
Own the core operator experience across mobile and desktop. Bring together the workflows restaurants rely on every day, including orders, guest issues, operational settings…
Build personalized business guidance. Show restaurants the value Owner is driving, identify the highest-impact opportunities, and deliver the right recommendation across product…
Scale unified guest and order management. Help restaurants monitor, manage, and resolve reviews, support requests, forms, order issues, and operational exceptions quickly.
Productize best-practice playbooks into simple actions. Turn proven operator and customer-success workflows into personalized recommendations, one-tap actions, and safe automation.
